articles.title_zh: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
facts_zh:
Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
- Published
A Russian cargo vessel that was hit by a drone attack in the eastern Gulf of Finland is being towed away, authorities have said.
The the Sparta II had been bound for Russia's Baltic exclave Kaliningrad when it was hit on Saturday morning, sparking a fire aboard.
It then drifted into Finnish waters and its crew were evacuated to Russia.

articles.title_zh: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
facts_zh:
Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
- Published
An explosion on a Russian ship docked at Benghazi naval base port was caused by a suspected drone attack, Libya's eastern government has said.
The explosion happened at dawn on Sunday, while the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia, Libyan state media reported, citing the eastern government.
It added that the site was secured, and there were no casualties.

articles.title_zh: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
facts_zh:
Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
- Published
At least three people have been killed after a fire at a confectionery factory in western Java on Saturday, with the death toll expected to rise.
Firefighters were still tackling some flames on Sunday, while rescuers searched for around 36 missing in parts of the damaged building where workers were believed to be trapped.
Indonesia's National Search and Rescue Agency said on Sunday 15 survivors had been located, and four others taken to hospital and a local clinic with undisclosed injuries.

all_titles.en: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory

He said he took full responsibility for the confusion caused by last-minute measures aimed at stopping AI-assisted cheating during Thursday's annual college entrance exam, known as Suneung.
A week ago, the top scorer in the national tax accountancy exam admitted using a mini-camera, mobile phone and AI tools.

articles.title_original: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
articles.title_zh: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
facts_zh:
Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
- Published
Italian jeweller Paolo Bulgari, who helped turn his family's business into a global luxury brand, has died in Rome aged age 89.
His family announced the news, remembering him as "the greatest jeweller of our time", according to Italian media.
Paolo Bulgari was Chairman of the Bvlgari Group since 1984 and its jewellery pieces have adorned Hollywood stars and royalty including Diana, Princess of Wales.

all_titles.en: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89

articles.title_original: Fire at confectionery factory in Indonesia leaves at least three dead and dozens missing
articles.title_zh: Fire at confectionery factory in Indonesia leaves at least three dead and dozens missing
facts_zh: Relatives of the missing victims flocked to the factory’s entrance, seeking updates about their loved ones A fire at a confectionery factory west of Jakarta has killed three people with 36 remaining missing, an Indonesian rescue official says.
Drone footage showed large parts of the factory destroyed, with the roof collapsed in places and smoke still rising from the complex.
Photos and videos shared by rescuers show officers entering the charred building in search of the missing victims on Sunday, with small fires still burning in some spots.

all_titles.en: Fire at confectionery factory in Indonesia leaves at least three dead and dozens missing
